name: Urban Enviro Waste Management Ltd.
summary: Urban Enviro Waste Management Ltd. is an Indian company specializing in comprehensive waste management and environmental services. The company's primary operations involve providing Municipal Solid Waste (MSW) management services, encompassing waste collection, transportation, segregation, processing, and disposal across India. Its services include door-to-door waste collection, road sweeping and cleaning, waste segregation, transportation to processing or disposal sites, processing of solid municipal waste, and bio-mining of legacy waste. Urban Enviro Waste Management primarily targets Indian Local Bodies, such as municipal corporations and urban local bodies, and also extends its services to residential areas, various industries, research institutes, power stations, government and semi-government hospitals, and cantonment boards. The company operates in states including Maharashtra, Gujarat, Rajasthan, Madhya Pradesh, Chhattisgarh, and Jammu and Kashmir, focusing on public sector service domains and securing long-term service contracts with municipalities.
